user.title: New curve
user.description: A curve calculates an output from time of day, month of year or sensor values. A target is optional.

data_description.name: For example "Circulation".
data_description.target_entity: Optional. Without a target the calculated output is available as a sensor.

data_description.interpolation: How the value changes between two points.
data_description.min_value: Lowest allowed value. Also the bottom of the chart.
data_description.max_value: Highest allowed value. Also the top of the chart.
data_description.step: Rounds the sensor output and optional target value to this step, e.g. 0.5.
data_description.unit: Unit for output sensors and the chart. Choose a Home Assistant unit, enter a custom unit, or leave empty for no unit.
data_description.holiday_source: Optional: a Workday binary sensor or a calendar (every event is a day off).
data_description.write_threshold: Optional target only: write when the value changes by at least this amount (0 = every change). Does not affect output sensors.
data_description.x_wrap: With wrapping the upper limit is exclusive. Otherwise out-of-range inputs clamp to the limits.
data_description.x_step: Point movement resolution; the sampled input is not rounded.
data_description.x_label_step: 0 = automatic. Minutes for time of day; otherwise X units. Independent of point snapping.
data_description.y_label_step: 0 = automatic; otherwise the spacing in output units.
data_description.watch_target: Keep external target adjustments as a persistent additive offset.
data_description.input_decimals: 0–6 decimal places for displayed numeric input values. Curve evaluation keeps full precision; clock times keep their time format.
data_description.output_tick: Recalculates sensors and the optional target at the selected interval. Use a value of at least 1, up to about 100 years; months must be whole numbers.
data_description.output_tick_unit: Days and weeks keep local clock time. Months follow the calendar, using the last day of shorter months when needed.

light_target.title: Light attribute
light_target.description: Choose one numeric attribute for this curve. Other color components are preserved when available. Commands can turn the light on; brightness 0 turns it off.

error.step_positive: The rounding step must be greater than 0.
error.threshold_negative: The threshold must not be negative.

error.invalid_axis: Enter finite ascending X limits and a positive resolution no larger than the range.

state.fallback: No activation matched — configured fallback plan

entry_not_found.message: Time profile instance {entry_id} was not found or is not loaded.

until_in_past.message: The end time must be in the future.

date_range_reversed.message: The end date must not be before the start date.

set_override.name: Set manual profile
set_override.description: Use one profile regardless of the weekly plan, optionally until a point in time.

until.name: Until
until.description: When to return to automatic mode. Leave empty to keep the profile until it is reset.

clear_override.name: Back to automatic
clear_override.description: End a manual profile and follow the weekly plan again.

add_exception.name: Add exception
add_exception.description: Use a profile for a date range, for example a holiday.

to.name: To
to.description: Last day (inclusive). Defaults to the first day.

remove_exception.name: Remove exception
remove_exception.description: Remove an exception by its ID or all exceptions covering a date.

date.name: Date
date.description: Remove all exceptions that include this day.

apply_now.name: Apply now
apply_now.description: Calculate and write the current value immediately.

clear_offset.name: Clear offset
clear_offset.description: Reset the persistent curve offset to zero.

anchor_collision.title: Anchor points collide: {name}
anchor_collision.description: The curve is unavailable and target writes are stopped. Correct the source value or anchor/partner assignments in the curve editor. This issue clears automatically. Details: {detail}
